title: Khaime me alam khoon me
body:
Khaime me alam khoo me dooba hua aaya hain,
Kya jaane sakina ne-2
Dil kaise sambhala hai
1) Sarwar ke sakina ka rukhsar jo nila-2
Islam ke chehre par bharpoor tamacha hain.
2) Khanjar ke labo par bhi maqtal me ye noha hai-2
Sukha hai gala sheh kaa kaate nahi kathta hai.
3) Jo shah ne Akbar ke seene se nikala tha-2
Ab tak dile laila me vo naiza khatakta hai.
4) Abbas ke laashe se ye kehke uthe sarwar-2
Mai khoob samajhta hoon maine kise khoya hain.
5) Zainab ne suna jisdum Abbas gaye maare-2
Chadar kaa sira kaskar mutthi me dabaya hai
6) Saahil pe koi jaakar Ghazi ko khabar karde-2
Darbar me zaalim ne Ghazi ko bulaya hai.
7) Besheer ne bhardi hai Islam ki bunyaade-2
Ya zere zami sheh ne ekk chand chupaya hai.
8) Rukhsaare Sakina par padte hai tamache jab-2
Ro roke koi laasha sahil pe tadapta hai.
9) kaano se Sakina ke jo chahe gauhar chine-2
Jo iska muhafiz tha
sahil pe vo sota hai.
10) Akbar ne sada di hai maidan se baba ko-2
Sarwar ki nigaaho me har samt andhera hai.
11) Karlena qubool aka "Zeeshan" kaa nazrana-2
Ya pehle pehel usne nouha koi likha hai.
